# CANDIDATE: VWAPCONT_DTE_OVERRIDE_ITM2_2DTE

**Filed:** 2026-08-24  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** wiring proposal  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Extending the DTE to 2 for the ITM-2 vwap_continuation signal will capture more edge by reducing theta decay, similar to the WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE finding. We hypothesize this passes walk-forward OOS validation (WF ≥ 0.70) and shows non-negative P&L on the top 3 J days within ±20% of BS-sim vs 0DTE baseline.

## Mechanism

Modify the vwap_continuation signal to use DTE=2 and strike=ITM-2 (overriding the current baseline which uses 0DTE and account-tier-dependent strike: Safe ITM/ATM, Bold ITM-2). Entry logic remains: first ≤10:30-ET bar continuing in-trend (breakout or pullback) when first 3 RTH closes are same side of session VWAP. Exit logic unchanged: chart-stop-primary (session extreme invalidation), chandelier profit-lock (+5% arm, 0.15 trail), TP1 at +50% (qty fraction 0.667), runner, time stop 15:50 ET.
